restrictions: The witness is the ordinary collision of the two distinct 128-byte messages in certificates/manifest.json under standard-IV SHA-256 reduced to steps 0 through 30, with FIPS padding and all 256 digest bits.
time_log2 36.9 and preprocessing_log2 36.9 are the same ceiling. The explicit sum in proof.md is 124514957609.646729 target compressions, whose base-2 logarithm is 36.857528, strictly below 2^36.9.
The scored program is a deterministic replay of that stored pair. Its construction cost is the counted run in proof.md Section 5, not an expected-time formula.

Every search trial is charged at 525 primitive 32-bit operations divided by 2140. Bitmap hits, record visits, V6 passes, and completion iterations are charged at the executed counters, not at a density estimate or an entry cap.
The z3 term charges three separate 1200-second single-core attempts at 6e9 cycles/s and 8 operations/cycle. It is the only score-critical measurement that is not an executed counter of the yield run.
This package claims no full SHA-256 collision and no 32-round collision. The promoted leader at the time of writing is 37.22.

heuristics.statement: The starting solution S used by the counted search is charged as three single-core z3 5.1.0 attempts, each at 6e9 cycles/s * 8 primitive 32-bit operations/cycle * 1200 seconds / 2140 = 26915887850.46729 target compressions. The three-attempt total is 80747663551.401871 and is included in the 36.9 sum.
heuristics.scope: Discovery of the starting solution S in proof.md, including failed attempts on the same characteristic. The yield-run counters are not part of this premise.
heuristics.extrapolation: z3 emits no collision-frontier-v5 trace. Eight operations per cycle is above a sustained integer throughput for this CPU, and 1200 seconds exceeds the successful bit-blast. Charging three full windows covers failed attempts even if the historical window was one 1200-second envelope. A retired-instruction trace, if smaller, would only lower the claim.
heuristics.limitations: This is not a retired-instruction receipt and not an organizer-executed z3 run. If a reviewer shows that the attempts exceeded 3*6e9*8*1200 primitive 32-bit operations, the ceiling is invalid. Crossing 2^36.9 total units invalidates the score.
